title: Special Delivery: The Pelican Pedal Express
description: A great white pelican pedals a turquoise beach cruiser along a timber seaside cycleway, carrying the morning fish delivery in a wicker rear hamper. His long hooked bill, orange throat pouch, curved white feathers, opposing webbed feet and enormous spoked wheels give the rider a jaunty silhouette.
